name: salt_line_deployer
counters: phantoms, spectres and apparitions that cross thresholds
lore: An unbroken salt line seals a doorway; spirits cannot cross it while it holds.

name: uv_lanterns
counters: shadow entities and phantoms that avoid light
lore: Ultraviolet light pins down shadow-bodied entities and makes residual echoes visible.

name: iron_filings_barrier
counters: fae, poltergeists and entities repelled by cold iron
lore: Cold iron disrupts the binding of restless spirits; a ring of filings holds them in place.

name: faraday_curtain
counters: entities feeding on electricity, network haunts and EMF surges
lore: A grounded mesh starves electrically active hauntings of the field they feed on.

name: thermal_flares
counters: cold spots and entities that drain heat from a room
lore: Sudden heat breaks the cold anchor a phantom draws strength from.

name: sage_smudge_drone
counters: lingering residual echoes and low-level apparitions
lore: A drone carries smudging smoke through vents to clear residue without sending people in.

name: sound_bath_speaker
counters: poltergeists that answer to rhythm, voice bleed and audio echoes
lore: A steady low tone out-of-phase with the entity's knocking calms poltergeist activity.

name: mirror_trap
counters: possession and entities that follow reflections
lore: An angled mirror lures a possessing spirit out of its host and into the glass.
risk: the mirror must be broken and buried after

name: holy_water_sprinklers
lore: Blessed water through the fire sprinklers drives out demonic presences sector-wide.
risk: soaks every laptop in the sector

name: decoy_pumpkins
counters: mobile phantoms that chase warmth and people
lore: Warm carved decoys draw a mobile entity away from pinned civilians.

name: bell_book_candle
lore: The old rite: ring, read, snuff. Banishes level-5 entities if completed uninterrupted.
risk: needs three operators for four minutes

name: fog_machine_shutoff
counters: false alarms caused by party effects, fog and lighting rigs
lore: Most 'sightings' at an event are the fog machine. Cut it and re-check the sensors.
